source.coordinates: All225 triples with default/origin/invertedY have identical five-column outputs. Generic hull endpoints are raw image Float32 coordinates; OvalRoi override scales integer-box endpoints by pw/ph. Neither includes calibration origin or invert-Y.
source.whole_image: Analyzer synthesizes unattached Roi: Feret/MinFeret/angle use pixels regardless of calibration. The raw_feret field attaches a separate diagnostic Roi, deliberately exposing this difference.
source.ellipse: OvalRoi.getFeretValues uses integer x/y, ceil width/height and analytic axes, not its processing contour hull. Strict height*ph > width*pw selects vertical; ties horizontal. Endpoints scaled by spacing, unlike generic Roi.
source.ordinary_hull: FloatPolygon order starts smallestY then smallestX and traverses left/bottom/right. Maximum uses strict greater-than pair scan; Float32 pair subtraction before promotion; chosen endpoints swapped only when first x>second x. Angle uses double endpoint differences, atan2 inverted y, add180 when negative. Min uses double edge normals and strict updates. Collinear hull MinFeret0; clipped/outside selections retain original geometry.
source.fitted: Actual Selection spline command observed; reuse original Float32 processing contour and admission, not control vertices.
source.native_affine: Not proved by Java: define physical-plane distance/angle extension explicitly before implementation. Preserve legacy coordinate units and whole-image fallback; do not silently substitute centroid/world positions.
